metadata.title: Club history
metadata.description: Liverpool FC — 20 league titles, 6 European Cups. Explore the club's timeline, trophy cabinet, legends, traditions and Anfield.

hero.foundingStory: Liverpool FC was born from a bitter dispute. In 1892, Everton FC left Anfield over a rent disagreement with stadium owner John Houlding. Left with an empty ground and no team, Houlding founded Liverpool Football Club on 15 March 1892. Admitted to the Football League the following year, Liverpool won their first league championship in 1901. What began with one man's resolve to keep football alive at Anfield grew into one of the most decorated and storied clubs in world sport.
hero.tagline: Since 1892 — 20 league titles, 6 European Cups and Anfield.

beginnings.name: Beginnings
beginnings.summary: Founded after Everton left Anfield, Liverpool claimed two league championships within 15 years and became an established First Division force.

shankly.name: The Shankly years
shankly.summary: Bill Shankly took over a Second Division side and built modern Liverpool: promotion, league titles, a maiden FA Cup and the Boot Room.

paisley.name: The glory years
paisley.summary: Under Paisley, Fagan and Dalglish, Liverpool dominated England and Europe across two decades marked by both silverware and the tragedies of Heysel and Hillsborough.

rebuild.name: Cup glory & Istanbul
rebuild.summary: The Premier League era brought unforgettable cup nights, none bigger than the 2001 cup treble in Dortmund and Cardiff and the Miracle of Istanbul in 2005.

klopp.name: The Klopp years
klopp.summary: Jürgen Klopp turned doubters into believers, delivering a sixth European Cup in 2019, a first Club World Cup, and the 2020 Premier League crown after a 30-year wait.

today.name: New era
today.summary: Arne Slot delivered a record-equalling 20th league title in 2025 before Andoni Iraola arrived in 2026 to lead a refreshed Anfield squad.

metadata.title: Legal
metadata.description: {brand} privacy policy, terms of use and data attributions. An independent, unofficial Liverpool FC news site.

Legal.title: Legal Information
Legal.contact: For legal, copyright or privacy enquiries, contact <email>nguyendangdinh47@gmail.com</email>

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: {brand} is an independent project and is not affiliated with Liverpool Football Club or Fenway Sports Group. We collect only the personal data needed for optional account features (email address, display name, avatar, saved items, player ratings and score predictions). Authentication and database storage are handled via Supabase, and gallery images are hosted on Cloudinary. We never sell or rent your personal information to third parties. Non-mirrored pages on the site may display Google AdSense advertisements, while mirrored news reader pages carry no ads. Google and its partners may use cookies to serve and measure ads, and you can manage personalised advertising at any time in your Google Ad Settings.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.content: This website is provided as-is for informational and editorial purposes only. {brand} is an unofficial fan-run site and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Liverpool FC or the Premier League. All club names, crests and trademarks remain the property of Liverpool Football Club and Athletic Grounds Limited or their respective owners. Match schedules, scores and standings are supplied by Football-Data.org and ESPN. News reader pages reproduce stories from the outlets listed below with prominent attribution and a direct link to the original publisher. Copyright in every external article belongs to its publisher or author; {brand} claims no ownership and acts promptly on any takedown or amendment request. Automated article translations, daily briefings and data-driven match reports use AI via VietAPI and may contain occasional errors. Continued use of this site constitutes acceptance of these terms.

sources.title: Data Sources
sources.content: League standings, fixtures and match results are provided by Football-Data.org. Domestic cup ties and live match events are supplemented by ESPN. Season player statistics come from the public Fantasy Premier League API, and first-team squad profiles come from liverpoolfc.com. News headlines and articles are gathered from 13 English outlets — LFC Official, BBC Sport, The Guardian, Liverpool Echo, This Is Anfield, Anfield Watch, Empire of the Kop, Sky Sports, Mirror, The Independent, Anfield Index, Liverpool.com and ESPN — always credited with a direct link to the original story. Vietnamese translations, daily briefings and match reports are generated with AI assistance via VietAPI. Club history, records and honours are curated from publicly verifiable archives.
